answer: Proof-of-location mitigates Sybil attacks by tying agent identities to verified physical coordinates via radio multilateration. At the dawn of each epoch, each falcon agent broadcasts cryptographic pings to anchor receivers on an elevated knoll. An attacker forging multiple identities incurs the scarce capital cost of deploying discrete transceivers across distinct spatial locations. However, multipath radio reflections and directional antennas can spoof arrival times to falsify coordinates.
